BiblicalUsage: Jiddo is an Israelite, a ruler of Manasseh in the days of David. In 1 Chronicles 27:21, Iddo the son of Zechariah. The fuller story is told on the Iddo, Son of Zechariah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Iddo shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
